text: Cycling offers an efficient and environmentally friendly way to travel around town or visit new areas, but it necessitates regular maintenance to ensure optimal performance. A cyclist's primary tool for controlling the bike's speed and power is the gear system, which enables adjustments for varying terrain and effort levels. A range of gears is essential to accommodate different riding conditions, from smooth pavement to hilly or challenging paths. Furthermore, it is crucial to wear a helmet to safeguard against head injuries and accidents.
